text.id: Tasya dateng ke warung Bu Sari jam sepuluh lewat, bawa es kopi literan yang udah berembun. Rambutnya diiket asal. Matanya bengkak, tapi lipstiknya rapi.
text.en: Tasya arrives at Bu Sari's stall just after ten, carrying a giant iced coffee already beaded with water. Her hair is tied up any old way. Her eyes are puffy, but her lipstick is perfect.

text.id: Hai. Sori telat. Gue muter tiga kali di gang, nggak berani masuk.
text.en: Hi. Sorry I'm late. I circled the alley three times, too scared to come in.

text.id: Gue dateng karena Dinda yang minta. Bukan karena lo.
text.en: I came because Dinda asked. Not because of you.

text.id: Duduk, Kak. Bu Sari udah bikinin teh.
text.en: Sit down. Bu Sari made you tea.

text.id: Tasya duduk di ujung bangku plastik, jauh dari gue. Es kopinya nggak diminum, cuma diputer-puter.
text.en: Tasya sits at the very end of the plastic bench, far from me. She doesn't drink her iced coffee, just turns it round and round.

text.id: Gue belum cerita semuanya. Waktu orang PR itu nelpon, dia nggak cuma nawarin duit.
text.en: I haven't told you everything. When that PR guy called, he didn't just offer money.

text.id: Dia nanya, "Selain Mbak Sekar, siapa lagi yang tahu soal dokumennya?" Kayak... dia udah tahu ada dokumen. Gue bahkan belum tahu waktu itu.
text.en: He asked, "Apart from Ms. Sekar, who else knows about the documents?" Like... he already knew there were documents. I didn't even know yet.

text.id: Terus dia bilang, "Kami sudah dengar dari orang dekatnya." Gue kira maksudnya gue. Biar gue ngerasa bersalah. Dan berhasil.
text.en: Then he said, "We've already heard from someone close to her." I thought he meant me. To make me feel guilty. And it worked.

text.id: Halaman yang disobek ada di HP Sekar. "Dia bukan jahat, dia butuh uang."
text.en: The torn-out page is on Sekar's phone. "She isn't bad, she needs the money."

text.id: Tasya baca sekali. Terus nutup mulutnya pake tangan, dan nangis tanpa suara, kayak orang yang udah latihan nangis tanpa ketahuan.
text.en: Tasya reads it once. Then she covers her mouth with her hand and cries without a sound, like someone who has practiced crying without being caught.

text.id: Dia masih belain gue. Waktu gue nggak bales chatnya. Dia masih belain gue.
text.en: She was still defending me. When I wasn't answering her messages. She was still defending me.

text.id: Satu lagi. mpus, yang di grup, dia anak IT. Dia DM gue semalem. Katanya dia ngecek nomor yang ngancem kalian.
text.en: One more thing. mpus, from the group, works in IT. He DMed me last night. He says he looked up the number that threatened you.
